description: Shared Renovate preset for house-starter and app-business-core (both extend it). #716: non-major and security updates merge themselves once every required check passes, in one weekly batch per repo; majors open one PR each for the CEO, after Claude Code has checked them.

packageRules.description: #716 weekly batch: every non-major update in one PR per repo, merged by GitHub only when the required checks pass. minimumReleaseAge matches the CI anti-slopsquatting gate (versions >= 14 days old), so the batch never proposes a version that gate would reject.

#716 majors: one PR each (monorepo siblings stay together), never automerged, labelled for the CEO. Replaces the HARD.06 G5 Dependency Dashboard approval hold, which kept majors invisible as PRs; the never-automerge, never-in-a-group-PR halves of G5 still hold.

A language-runtime minor (Python 3.11 -> 3.15) is a breaking upgrade in practice - core #218 broke the semgrep gate - so it is handled like a major: its own PR, never automerged, never in the weekly batch.

The reusable workflows in PiersAG/app-business-core are called by uses: refs in this repo, but that repo is private and has no Renovate app install, so every lookup fails with no-result and surfaces as an error on the Dependency Dashboard. Nothing to update here - these refs are pinned by hand.
